mostWorthwhile.text: Receiving the shipment at the clinic was the strongest payoff: the local route and offline intake overcame the original address rejection without pretending the corporate service had changed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pump and controller at the monitor felt like procedural preparation rather than meaningful decisions; neither placement itself showed a service working.

surprise.text: The final desk closed only the confirmed clinic request and left Tin Row's slow tap open, turning the status display into a useful distinction between reported and completed work.

arbitrary.text: Combining Moth's morning desk with the received shipment was not clearly connected to the remaining request goal beforehand; I followed the only offered gameplay action.

continue.text: I would continue for the neighborhood's unresolved work and the practical consequences of local control, though I would hope for fewer purely preparatory placements.
